book.title: EXODO ÃCÕRẼBA ISRAELERÃ EGIPTOD̸EBEMA ẼDRɅ B̸ɅD̸A

content: Ne drʌad̶a jẽda diaid̶ebema ley
Bariduaba pacada wa ovejada drʌaped̶a beaibʌrʌ wa nẽdobueibʌrʌ, naʌ̃ quĩrãca oida b̶ʌa. Pacada drʌasira paca juesuma jẽda diaida b̶ʌa. Ovejada drʌasira oveja quĩmãrẽ jẽda diaida b̶ʌa.
Bariduada diamasi ne drʌa b̶ʌd̶e de djibariba beaibʌrʌ, mĩã bead̶a carea bed̶ead̶e b̶aẽ́a.

Baribʌrʌ ãsa de djibariba maʌ̃ ne drʌa b̶ʌda beaibʌrʌ, mĩã bead̶a carea bed̶ead̶e b̶aya. Bariduada ne drʌaped̶a jidad̶ibʌrʌ, idjia drʌad̶abari jẽda diaida b̶ʌa. Jẽda diai carea neẽ́ b̶ʌbʌrʌ, idjira nezoca bamãrẽã nẽdobued̶ida panʌa idjia drʌad̶abari jẽda diad̶i carea.
Bariduaba pacada, burroda, wa ovejada drʌaibʌrʌ, idji jidabʌdad̶e maʌ̃ animarãda wad̶i zocai erob̶ʌbʌrʌ, jẽda diaida b̶ʌa. Maʌ̃ awara ab̶a aud̶u diaida b̶ʌa.

Bariduaba idji ẽjũãne wa uva u erob̶ʌma idji animarãda ne cod̶amãrẽã ẽrãbueibʌrʌ, baribʌrʌ maʌ̃ animarãra djãrã ẽjũãne ne cod̶e wãnibʌrʌ, djibarira bed̶ead̶e b̶ʌa. Maʌ̃ bẽrã dji ẽjũã djibaría idji néud̶ebema dji biara b̶ʌda diaida b̶ʌa.
Bariduaba idji ẽjũã babuebʌrʌd̶e djãrã néu ewad̶ada wa ewaẽ́ b̶ʌ sid̶a bá wãibʌrʌ, dji bád̶aba jũma dji bá wãnabari diaida b̶ʌa.
Ab̶aʌba paratada wa ne bariduada djãrã ded̶e waga erob̶ʌd̶e dewaraʌba drʌaibʌrʌ, dji ne drʌad̶ara jidad̶aped̶a idjia drʌad̶ada jẽda diaida b̶ʌa. Maʌ̃ awara ab̶a aud̶u diaida b̶ʌa.
Baribʌrʌ dji ne drʌad̶ada jidad̶aẽ́bʌrʌ, dji ne waga erob̶ad̶ara bãrã bororãmaa eded̶ida panʌa. Maʌ̃be ãdjia quĩrãcuita iwid̶id̶ida panʌa idjia maʌ̃ ne waga erob̶ad̶ara drʌasi cawaya.
Paca carea, burro carea, oveja carea, cacuad̶e jʌ̃bada carea, ne baridua adua b̶ad̶a carea bid̶a ijarad̶ibʌrʌ, ãdjira bãrã bororãmaa wãnida panʌa.
Maʌ̃ne dji bororãba quĩrãcuita iwid̶id̶aped̶a cawa jarad̶ia caida bed̶ead̶e b̶ʌda. Maʌ̃be dji bed̶ead̶e b̶ʌba djibaría ãdji ijara panʌ careabemada umé diaida b̶ʌa.

Bariduaba burroda, pacada, ovejada, wa baridua animarã sid̶a dewaraa wagabi b̶ʌd̶e maʌ̃ animarãda beuibʌrʌ, wa cawaẽ́ne idub̶a puaibʌrʌ, wa ni ab̶aʌba ununaẽ́ne drʌad̶ibʌrʌ, dji animarã waga erob̶ad̶aba Ãcõrẽ quĩrãpita wãrãneba jaraida b̶ʌa maʌ̃ animarã drʌaẽ́ b̶ʌda. Maʌ̃ jarad̶ara djibariba ĩjãida b̶ʌa. Mãwãra dji animarã waga erob̶ad̶aba djibaría maʌ̃ animarãbari diaiẽ́ b̶ʌa.
Baribʌrʌ idjia idu drʌabibʌrʌ, maʌ̃ animarãbari djibaría diaida b̶ʌa.
Idjia waga erob̶ʌ animarãda mẽãbema animarãba beaibʌrʌ, dji beud̶ara edeida b̶ʌa acʌbi carea mẽãbema animarãba wãrãda beasida. Mãwãra maʌ̃ animarãbari djibaría diaiẽ́ b̶ʌa.
Bariduaba trajabada animarãda iwid̶i edeped̶a djibari neẽ́ne maʌ̃ animarãra idub̶a puaibʌrʌ wa beuibʌrʌ, dji eded̶aba maʌ̃ animarãbari djibaría diaida b̶ʌa.

Baribʌrʌ maʌ̃ animarã puabʌrʌd̶e wa beubʌrʌd̶e djibarida aria b̶aibʌrʌ, dji animarã eded̶aba maʌ̃ animarãbari diaiẽ́ b̶ʌa. Idjab̶a maʌ̃ animarã edei carea paratada diasibʌrʌ, maʌ̃ animarãda idub̶a puaibʌrʌ wa beuibʌrʌ, dji eded̶aba maʌ̃ animarãbari waa diaiẽ́ b̶ʌa.
Jipa od̶i careabema ley

Ẽberãba wẽrã umaquĩrã adua b̶ʌda cũrũgaped̶a idji ume cãĩbʌrʌ, maʌ̃ wẽrãra dewara ume quima edai carea bed̶ea b̶ʌẽ́ b̶ʌbʌrʌ, maʌ̃ ẽberãba quima edai careabema paratara dji wẽrã zezaa diaida b̶ʌa idjab̶a dji wẽrãra edaida b̶ʌa.
Baribʌrʌ dji wẽrã zezaba idji cauda maʌ̃ ẽberãa dia quĩrĩãẽ́bʌrʌ, dji ẽberãba maʌ̃ wẽrãra edaẽ́mĩna quima edai careabema paratara diaida b̶ʌa.
Jũma jãĩbana wẽrãrãda bead̶ida panʌa.
Bariduaba animarãda oibʌrʌ, idjira bead̶ida panʌa.
Bariduaba animarãda mʌ̃́a babue diai cãyãbara dewara ãcõrẽa babue diaibʌrʌ, idjira bead̶ida panʌa.
Ãĩbema bãrã tãẽna b̶eada biẽ́ orãnadua. Quĩrãnebad̶adua bãrã sid̶a Egiptod̶e ãĩbemarã basida.
Pẽdra wẽrãra wa jẽrãmãrã sid̶a biẽ́ orãnadua.
Bãrãba ãdjirã biẽ́ o panʌ carea mʌ̃́a quĩrã djuburiada iwid̶id̶ibʌrʌ, ãdjia iwid̶i panʌra mʌ̃a ũrĩped̶a carebaya.
Mʌ̃ quĩrũbid̶eba iduaribiya dji quĩrũba djõne zed̶aped̶a bãrãra necoba bead̶ida. Mãwã bãrã quimara pẽdra bad̶ia idjab̶a bãrã warrarã sid̶a jẽrãmãrã bad̶ia.
Mʌ̃ purud̶ebema ne neẽ́ quiruba parata iwid̶id̶ara diad̶ibʌrʌ, idjia jẽda diabʌrʌd̶e aud̶u iwid̶irãnadua ʌ̃cʌrʌba aud̶u jẽda diabibada quĩrãca.

Bariduaba parata iwid̶id̶a wãrãda jẽda diaida cawabi carea idjia jĩsua carea jʌ̃barida b̶eibʌrʌ, dji parata diad̶aba maʌ̃ra erob̶eiẽ́ b̶ʌa. Queui naẽna dji parata diad̶aba maʌ̃ra diad̶e wãida b̶ʌa djibariba boro cãĩ carea waa neẽ́ b̶ʌ bẽrã. Diad̶e wãẽ́bʌrʌ, djibariba jĩsua carea mʌ̃́a quĩrã djuburiada iwid̶ibʌrʌ, mʌ̃a carebaya mʌ̃ra quĩrã djuburiaid̶a b̶ʌ bẽrã.
Mʌ̃da, bãrã bororã sid̶a biẽ́ jararãnadua.
Mʌ̃a b̶ʌd̶a ewarid̶e bãrã néu naãrã ewabʌdad̶ebemada, uva b̶ad̶ebema sid̶a arid̶e diad̶adua. Jũma bãrã umaquĩrã warra dji nabema tobʌrʌda mʌ̃́a diad̶ida panʌa.

Paca umaquĩrã dji nabema tobʌrʌda, oveja umaquĩrã dji nabema tobʌrʌ sid̶a bãrãba jũma mʌ̃́a bea diad̶ida panʌa. Maʌ̃ animarã zaquera dji papa ume siete ewaribe b̶aya. Nurẽma ochobema ewarid̶e mʌ̃́a bea diad̶ida panʌa.
Bãrã israelerãra mʌ̃ itea bia b̶ead̶ida panʌa. Maʌ̃ bẽrã baridua animarã mẽãbemaba bead̶ada bãrãba cod̶acara panʌa. Maʌ̃ djarara usaa diad̶adua cod̶amãrẽã.
